name: Body and Heart
summary: At the Moonkin Stone, you face a trial of body and heart to master Bear Form. Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids from Thunder Bluff to summon and defeat Lunaclaw near the border of Mulgore and the Barrens.

sections.title: The Way of the Claw
sections.body: Turak Runetotem tests young tauren druids who seek the path of the Druid of the Claw. After you commune with the Great Bear Spirit in Moonglade, your training turns to a trial of strength. Turak, the elder druid trainer atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, gives worthy aspirants Cenarion Lunardust. He sends you to a sacred stone near the dry frontier where Mulgore meets the Barrens.

sections.title: The Trial of Lunaclaw
sections.body: West of Camp Taurajo, the Moonkin Stone marks a rare Cenarion site in southern Kalimdor. Moonkin are not native to the sun-scorched plains of central Kalimdor, and Lunaclaw guards the stone. Scatter the lunardust across the ancient monument to call Lunaclaw into battle. Defeating the guardian proves your strength and clarity of heart, earning its blessing and awakening the bear's inner essence.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
aliases: what does body and heart do
what do i get from body and heart
faq.answer: The trial is the final step for Horde druids seeking Bear Form. By meeting its challenge, you prove yourself ready to follow the path of the Druid of the Claw under Turak Runetotem's guidance.

faq.q: Where is the Moonkin Stone located?
faq.answer: The Moonkin Stone lies in the Barrens, west of Camp Taurajo along the road toward the Mulgore gate. Just south of the road, behind a tree near a lone tent, you find the sacred stone.
Lunaclaw is a fierce moonkin guardian bound to the Moonkin Stone. Cenarion Lunardust summons it to test whether you have the resolve and calm needed to wield the bear's power.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the battle against Lunaclaw?
faq.answer: If Lunaclaw defeats you, your Cenarion Lunardust is spent. Return to Turak Runetotem atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for another pouch of dust before trying again.

faq.q: Are moonkin native to the Barrens?
faq.answer: No. Moonkin are not native to the Barrens or Mulgore. Lunaclaw is an unusual sight on the savannah, bound to Cenarion rites and ancient sites of celestial power.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Body and Heart?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem gives this challenge to initiates returning from Moonglade. He is the senior druid trainer on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a druid, this rite joins Cenarion teachings with tauren heritage. It lets you take on Bear Form and its fierce resilience.
As Shu'halo, awakening the bear within joins communion with nature spirits and a way to defend Mulgore's plains from encroaching threats.
As a tauren druid, you bring resilience to the Horde's front lines and ground its magic in the guardianship of the wild.
